title: Sections over a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object commute with filtered colimits of sheaves of modules
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the category of sheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U\to X$ be an object of $X_{\Et}$ such that the scheme $U$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category, $i\mapsto\mathcal G_i$ a diagram $\mathcal I\to\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$, and $(\mathcal G,(c_i)_{i})$ a colimit of it in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the canonical map
$$
\Psi:\varinjlim_i\mathcal G_i(U)\longrightarrow\mathcal G(U),
$$
the unique map (colimit of the sets, equivalently of the $\Lambda$-modules, $\mathcal G_i(U)$) whose composite with the coprojection of $\mathcal G_i(U)$ is $(c_i)_U$, is bijective.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 7.17.7 (Tag 0738, label lemma-directed-colimits-sections), part (4), applied to the etale site as in Etale Cohomology, Section 59.51 'Colimits' (Tag 03Q4, label section-colimit, first paragraph): a quasi-compact quasi-separated object has the cofinal system of finite coverings by affine objects, whose pairwise fibre products are quasi-compact.
